candidates.query: SELECT ?f WHERE { ?f a :Fab . ?p a :Product . ?c a :CapacityConstraint . ?c :constraint_type ?c_constraint_type . ?p :PRODUCES ?f . ?p :HAS_CONSTRAINT ?c . FILTER(?c_constraint_type = 'production_bottleneck') }
SELECT DISTINCT ?f WHERE { ?f a :Fab . ?l a :Lot . ?d a :Defect . ?t a :Tool . ?l :PRODUCES ?f . ?l :HAS_DEFECT ?d . ?l :PROCESSED_WITH ?t . }
SELECT ?f WHERE { ?f a :Fab . ?p a :Product . ?s a :Shipment . ?p :PRODUCES ?f . ?p :DEPENDS_ON ?s . ?s :HAS_STATUS ?anon1 . ?anon1 :name ?anon1_name . FILTER(?anon1_name = 'delayed') }

SELECT ?f WHERE { ?f a :Fab . ?i a :Inventory . ?p a :Product . ?c a :CapacityConstraint . ?c :constraint_type ?c_constraint_type . ?i :PRODUCES ?f . ?i :STOCKS ?p . ?p :HAS_CONSTRAINT ?c . FILTER(?c_constraint_type = 'production_bottleneck') }
